ZXing-WASM 3.1.4
Source: https://github.com/Sec-ant/zxing-wasm/tree/v3.1.4
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/zxing-wasm/-/zxing-wasm-3.1.4.tgz

zxing-reader.js is package/dist/iife/reader/index.js, renamed without edits.
zxing_reader.wasm is package/dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm, without edits.
Both files and LICENSE were verified byte-for-byte against the npm package.
ZXing-WASM is MIT licensed. Its ZXing-C++ dependency is Apache-2.0 licensed;
LICENSE-zxing-cpp is retained alongside LICENSE.
The scanner sets locateFile explicitly so the WebAssembly stays same-origin.
